name: usage-pacer
description: Pace your Claude usage so you never run out of limits. Tracks the 5-hour (5h) and weekly (1w) windows against a linear budget toward a cap you set (default 90%): a colored bar above the prompt, a badge in the session title and a status-line entry go green on pace and yellow, orange, red as you run ahead, with a warning before the cap. Everything is configured with /budget.

cap.title: Cap (%)
cap.description: The usage at which the signal turns red and the alert fires. The linear budget is the elapsed share of each window times this cap.

threshold.title: Far-ahead threshold (points)
threshold.description: How many points over the linear budget count as far ahead of pace. The levels slightly over, over, well over and far over are thirds of it.

title.title: Badge in the session title
title.description: Put the 5h and 1w usage in front of the session title. It updates when a session starts and on each prompt you send.

strip.title: Strip below the title
strip.description: Draw a colored 5h and 1w strip as the window backdrop (desktop and mobile apps). The app's own colors never change.

promptBar.title: Bar above the prompt
promptBar.description: Show the 5h and 1w bars above the prompt, with the pace and the reset time.

statusLine.title: Status line entry
statusLine.description: Show the 5h and 1w usage in the status line.

colorMode.title: Color by
colorMode.description: pace: the color follows how far ahead of the linear budget you are. ranges: the color follows the usage reached, in the ranges you set with the /budget panel.

colorOk.title: Color: on pace
colorOk.description: Usage at or under the linear budget.

colorOver2.title: Color: over pace
colorOver2.description: Over the linear budget by a third of the threshold.

colorOver3.title: Color: well over
colorOver3.description: Over the linear budget by two thirds of the threshold.

colorOver4.title: Color: far over
colorOver4.description: Over the linear budget by the whole threshold or more.

colorCap.title: Color: at the cap
colorCap.description: Usage at or past the cap.
